english: Things have gotten bad, nyo...\nBut I won't let them have Gamers, nyo!\nI'm ready to go scorched-earth if I have to, nyo!!
I don't think the shoplifting-prevention interception system\nwill do the trick, nyu.
Better than nothing, nyo!
The group that was fighting the blonde monster\nwas an outrageous bunch of brawlers too, nyo...
If things like that attack, we're in trouble, nyo...\nBut I'll protect the treasure goods in this store\nto the bitter end, nyo!!
Is that really what you should be protecting, nyu.
[Battle map: Gamers 1F]
Nyo!? They're here, nyo!!
Lucky there are no customers, nyu.
[Deploy allies]
The brawler gang's here too, nyo!!
Huh? Something seems a little... off?
Hawa, hawawa, so many\nlovely customers-uu!!
Ugeh, calling THOSE\ncustomers is\nkind of a stretch...
Aren't those enemies, I wonder?
How else could you see it!
Are they being attacked?
They seem to be heading for the upper floors.
Let's beat them without damaging the store\nas much as possible!
Ehh! No-damage is impossible, impossible!\nSorry to the store, but let's just\ndo it like always!
Hmm, I'm not sure about that either...
[Battle starts / event when reaching the escalator (stairs?) on the floor]
We can get to the upper floor from here.
There may be enemies that went up ahead!
Let's hurry up!
How many floors are there?
Um, the 5th floor is the top!
Stairs to the 5th floor... I see,\nlet's proceed carefully!
I agree with Blue Angel-san-uu!\nWe don't know what's up there-uu.
I feel like charging right through\nis better for stuff like this, though.
Stairs are tou— uh, I mean, I'd feel bad\ntrashing the store too much!
If they tell us to pay for damages,\nthat'd be bad...\nbut it can't be helped.
[Battle ends /]
Lots on this floor too!
They noticed us! Here they come!
I'll take point!
Me too-uu!
Me too! Me too!! Cover me, okay!
[Battle starts / event when reaching the escalator (stairs?) on the floor]
Next is the 3rd floor!
Easy!
Let's keep going!
[Battle ends / can save]
3rd floor, we're halfway.
I'm still full of energy!
No letting our guard down — steadily!
[Battle starts / event when reaching the escalator (stairs?) on the floor]
We go up to the next floor from here.
Is someone on the top floor...!\nThen we have to hurry and help!
[Battle ends / can save]
4th floor. One more above this.
Let's move, quickly!
Louise-san, are you okay on magic-uu?
I'm fine. I'm holding back well!
Louise-san, aren't you tired?
Surprisingly, I'm not tired.\nDon't know why, but I feel great!
Then, battle start!
[Battle starts / event when reaching the escalator (stairs?) on the floor]
The top floor at last!
If we take the floor above,\nthat'll mean we've wiped out the enemy.
T-take!? A-awawa, that's violent!
Um... this is a store,\nSonico-san...
[Battle ends / can save]
The top floor!
[Dejiko addresses them.]
Well done climbing up here, you brawler gang, nyo!
Brawler gang? Us?
You, nyo!!\nThe monitors on every floor showed you going wild, nyo!
Ara, you were watching...
Oh? Aren't you the one who\nran away from the battle outside...?
Gamers clerk —\nbut my true identity is the ruler of Akihabara,\nDejiko, nyo!
Outlaws who trample into sacred Gamers with shoes on\nand ravage Akihabara!\nWill be punished by Dejiko-sama, nyo!!
Um... I thought it was fine to wear shoes\ninside Gamers...?
You there! No nitpicking, nyo!
Anyone with complaints, bring it, nyo!!\nI'll treat you to a beam of justice, nyo!!
That girl... she's kinda lovely-uu!\nThat slightly bad-girl face\nis irresistible-uu!!
C-calm down...\nBetter not approach carelessly...
What are you saying-uu!\nShe wouldn't sell as the orthodox type,\nbut she'll definitely break out in some form-uu!
She's my kind of idol-uu!!
Ahh... her eyes are serious...
I don't hate that fighting spirit!\nLow energy is boring!
I'll get serious just this once, nyo!!
[Battle starts / event when engaging Dejiko / Puchiko appears near Dejiko]
They took the bait, nyu.
Something appeared!
Another little one showed up.
I'll grow more than you, nyu.
What did you say!?
Puchiko! Pincer attack, nyo!
Treat me to rare steak later, nyu.
[Event when Dejiko is defeated; battle ends]
Nyo... you're ridiculously strong, nyo...
With that strength,\nyou sure talked big?\nI'm almost impressed...
...How frustrating, nyo.\nI couldn't protect Gamers, nyo.
Protect...?\nUm, a bit late, but we're\nnot your enemies.
Nyo?
Sonico brought us to this store\nbecause she knows this town well.
But the store was in big trouble,\nso if anyone was here, we had to help!\nThat's what I thought...
You didn't come here to trash the place too, nyo?
Um, you were watching us fight\non the monitors, right?
Weren't you fighting over\nwho gets to take over Gamers, nyo?
A shop for commoners like this\ndoesn't suit me at all!
I agree with that.\nIt looks interesting, but\nI don't want it for myself.
...You could've\nsaid that earlier, nyo~.
[Battle ends / BG: inside Gamers]
Sheesh, I went through hell, nyo.
Sorry, Dejiko-chan.
That's just Dejiko's act, nyu.\nDon't worry about it, nyu.
Wah!? You're so little,\nbut you're a comedian!?
Not a comedian, nyo!\nDejiko is an actress, nyo!
Wow, an actress! Then for this\nshoot, you're my senior! Um,\nI'm Super Sonico!
Dejiko, nyo!\nShowbiz has a strict hierarchy,\nso serve your senior well, nyo.
Yes! Dejiko-senpai!\nPlease take care of me!
Someone's being fooled, nyu.
As expected! Showbiz would never\nleave Dejiko-san alone-uu!
I think there's about one\ngenuine fan here...
There are all kinds of idiots, nyu.
By the way, why was\nthis store attacked?
Other places weren't attacked, nyo?
Yes, everywhere else is perfectly peaceful?
So it IS the giant game store or\ngiant anime store's doing, nyo!?
Stop spreading defamation, nyu.
Sheesh, even coming here,\nI still have no idea\nwhat this town is like!
Wanna know about Akihabara, nyo?\nThen let me show you a good place\nand take a break too, nyo.
This won't turn into another brawl, will it?
It's fine, nyo. Let's go, nyo~!
[Event art: Siesta's full-fledged maid technique]
Welcome, master.\nAllow me to show you in.
Wah~! It's a maid café~!
When you say Akihabara, you say maid cafés, nyo.\n...Or I'd like to say, but\nwhy is that girl working instead of having tea, nyo?
You there,\nstraighten your back when you walk, it's unsightly.\nAnd you there, smaller steps!
Siesta's a first-class maid even the princess acknowledges.\nShe just can't stay quiet, can she?
The customers in the store\nare all watching Siesta-san too.
The maids look\na little troubled, though...
Siesta-san,
More tea, I presume?\nHere you are.
My!\nHow did you know what I was about to say?
If you put yourself in the customer's shoes,\nyou can tell what's wanted\ntwo steps ahead.
And by shortening the wait,\nthey can have a more pleasant time.\nThat's Maid Basics.
Siesta-san's amazing-uu!\nShe's too dazzling-uu!
She's got the air of a master!\nGreat posture, and s-so cool! It gives me chills! I admire her!
Fufu, I'm honored.
[Event art off]
The maid café was fun.\nI did good work.
In just one hour,\nyou'd become the most popular one.
On the way out, the manager was\nbegging you, 'Please work for us!'
Of course, with Siesta's skill.
Beautiful conduct alone\ncan move people.
She's like a teacher from Saint Mont Blanc Academy's\nMagical Maid Department-uu
Why not take an apprentice and raise one?\nA single successor — a legendary maid!\nHow cool would that be? Ahaha
Feels like the wrong way to use a maid café,\nnyo...\nbut if she's satisfied, fine, nyo.
Gonna hit the bathroom, nyu.
[Puchiko leaves]
By the way, Dejiko-san,\nif enemies attacked this store,\nwasn't there a reason it was targeted?
For example, something precious stored here\nthat they came for.
Like that time someone was after\nthe 'Angel's Tear' that Aoi-san has?
Things worth stealing...\njust my hidden treasure goods, nyo?
You've got valuables?
There's a vault on the top floor, nyo.\nLet me check if anything's missing, nyo.
[BG: inside the warehouse (something appropriate)]
Nyo-nyo?\nA few limited-edition games\nare gone, nyo?
So a thief broke in?
Isn't that a big problem?
They're not that valuable, nyo.
What IS this vault?\nIt's full of even more nonsensical stuff\nthan the Tristain Academy of Magic's treasury!
Naked dolls, suspicious runes,\nshiny clothes, and is this a replica sword?
Limited-edition figures and voice actor autographs,\nan idol voice actress's stage costume,\nand the greatsword used at an event, nyo.
All priceless items, nyo~.
But those weren't stolen.\nWhat was the culprit after, I wonder?
Also, this box was empty, nyo.
What was in that box?
Forgot, nyo.\nIt was a box I just tossed stuff into,\nso it's probably nothing important, nyo.
Really?
It wasn't even sealed, and the stuff inside\nwas covered in dust, so it's junk, nyo.\nScrap or something, nyo.
Isn't this a place where only\nimportant things are stored?
Yeah, but I secretly\nstashed some of my own stuff here too, nyo.\nMight've been related to that, nyo~?
I hope it wasn't anything important...
Nyo? Did someone point a flashlight this way, nyo?\nIt's bright, nyo!!
[Light appears]
No! This light!!
Nyo-nyo!?
No way, here!?
[Everyone vanishes / Puchiko arrives.]
Dejiko, what was that light, nyu?
[Event art: Puchiko tilting her head slightly, like "nyu?"]
Nyu?
Why is nobody here, nyu?
Nyu? This empty box is...
[Event art off / scene change / BG: Akihabara]
I stole limited-edition games and sketchy gadgets\nfrom the Gamers warehouse, but\nno clue if any of this is actually useful.
This gadget that keeps my backlog pile from toppling\nseems handy, though.
Then there's the device that turns you into a creepy snail,\nthe device that prays you win doujin event lotteries,\nthe alarm that rings when you doze off... don't need it!
And a device that tells you when you accidentally buy\na doujinshi you already own,\nand a device that turns you into low-poly CG, apparently.
No idea what any of this is good for... hmm?\nWhat's this little one...?
A lie detector, it says.\nHuh, smaller than a lighter —\nthis could be useful for something!
[END]
